title: Research: exact four-call minimum for an integer-shear target
body:
## Summary

This package specifies the nonabelian address group generated by two opposite integer shears
\[
X=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix},\qquad
Y=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\1&1\end{pmatrix}
\]
with paid labels \(X^{\pm1},Y^{\pm1}\). Each is a reversible integer update with rank-one difference from identity.

For \(B=X^2Y^2=\begin{pmatrix}5&2\\2&1\end{pmatrix}\), the exact minimum for
\[
\operatorname{diag}([B],[e])\in M_2(\mathbb F_2[G])
\]
is four paid calls. The word using \(X,X,Y,Y\) acts on every dirty pair \((u,v)\) as \((Bu,v)\).

## Proof and bill

Each paid factor contributes only the identity label or its chosen generator label. Thus a k-factor operator cannot contain an address outside the radius-k word ball. B is absent from all 85 words of length at most three, giving the lower bound for arbitrary rank-one idempotent frames. The explicit four-call word attains it.

The complete model-local bill is four paid factors, two arbitrary dirty roles, no scratch roles, and zero copy, reset, restore or uncharged address calls. The second role is unchanged.

## Scope and credit

The result changes the address group from the additive rational-frame model to a specified nonabelian integer-shear group. It is a scoped exact minimum only. No bit supplier, physical compiler invoice, recursive moment, new kappa, or selected-frontier change is claimed.

The package records overlap with the all-S_n adjacent-transposition tariff, free-group commutator-pair and UT5(Z) four-role claims, and current UT3(F4) work. It retains credit to the earlier register-model line, including PR #288 and PR #203. Exact heads and sources are in research/sl2z-four-call-native-target/OVERLAP.md and SOURCES.json.

## Publication validation

The registered package replay passed on CPython 3.12.3 with `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/sl2z-four-call-native-target`. This package's source manifest pins only files at its exact base commit `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; it contains no `head:` source pins. Any earlier pending note above refers to the state before this publication-time replay.
